title: NAT Gateway
explanation: A NAT Gateway enables instances in private subnets to connect to the internet or other AWS services while preventing the internet from initiating connections to those instances. It is a managed, highly available service that operates within a single Availability Zone.
analogy: A NAT Gateway is like a mail forwarding service for your private rooms — residents can send letters out, but no one outside can send unsolicited mail directly to them.
keyPoints: NAT Gateway is AZ-scoped — deploy one per AZ for high availability
Supports up to 55,000 simultaneous connections to each unique destination
Charged per hour and per GB of data processed
Must be placed in a public subnet with an Elastic IP

examKeywords.definition: A managed AWS service that enables outbound internet access for resources in private subnets while blocking inbound connections.

commonMistakes: Deploying a single NAT Gateway for multi-AZ architectures — creates a single point of failure
Confusing NAT Gateway (managed) with NAT Instance (self-managed EC2)
